inputs.text: President Abinader is once again revealing his misplaced loyalties by chasing applause from global outfits instead of standing up for Dominican sovereignty and the traditional values that have preserved order in our society for generations. On 25 March 2026 in Paris he stood by while Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez signed a Memorandum of Understanding with OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann to roll out the Dominican Republic's first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. This is nothing more than another surrender of control over our domestic affairs to outside progressive institutions that care little for strong national authority, personal responsibility, or the family and faith roots that actually hold our culture together. We would be far better off relying on our own traditions and leaders rather than opening the door to foreign interference.
